entities.name: Akiri
entities.description: A kor line-slinger and veteran who guards a merfolk caravan down the Magosi Steps and fights the serpent Verazol.

entities.name: Zareth
entities.description: A merfolk adventurer and Akiri's friend who sacrifices part of the caravan as a distraction to save Akiri.

entities.name: Verazol
entities.description: A legendary two-headed serpent of the Magosi, a beast hundreds of feet long that devours the caravan.

entities.name: Merfolk caravan
entities.description: Two dozen merfolk traders and their pillarfield oxen carrying goods to Coralhelm, mostly killed by Verazol.

entities.name: Caravan leader
entities.description: An unnamed merfolk leader of the caravan.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The aberrant beings Zareth's people once called gods, defeated in the Battle.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's planar fever and warning, which returns as a tremor that morning.

entities.name: Battle for Zendikar
entities.description: The war against the Eldrazi at Sea Gate.

entities.name: Magosi Falls
entities.description: The tall waterfall along the Umara River Gorge where Verazol lurks.

entities.name: Magosi Steps
entities.description: Switchback stairs carved beside Magosi Falls down the gorge wall.

entities.name: Magosi Portage
entities.description: The rest stop atop Magosi Falls where the caravan begins.

entities.name: Sea Gate
entities.description: The city Akiri and Zareth are returning to.

entities.name: Coralhelm
entities.description: A merfolk settlement that was the caravan's destination.

entities.name: Umara River Gorge
entities.description: The gorge running to the Halimar.

entities.name: Makindi-kor hook
entities.description: The hook Zareth gave Akiri, used in her swings.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The wounded plane whose pain produces the Roil.

events.summary: At dawn the caravan prepares to descend the Magosi Steps with Akiri and Zareth as guards.
A Roil tremor shakes the portage; Akiri stays calm and reassures the caravan.
events.quote: The Roil—gone briefly after the Eldrazi defeat at Sea Gate—was back.

events.summary: The caravan begins descending the steps into thick mist.
events.quote: The caravan, Akiri, and Zareth continued down

events.summary: An ox breaks its ankle on a loose cobble and is put down.
A giant serpent emerges from the mist, attacking the head of the caravan, and Akiri leaps off the switchback to fight it while Zareth draws his knives.
events.quote: She coiled, sprinted, and then leapt off the switchback

events.summary: Akiri climbs Verazol's back toward its eyes, but its second head knocks her from the beast and she falls.
events.quote: The second mouth flings her to the side, into the open air.

events.summary: Zareth recognizes the serpent as Verazol and scrambles back up the stairs, then resolves to fight beside Akiri.
Akiri survives the fall onto a lower switchback, but Verazol's main head looms over her.
events.quote: It bites, and Akiri holds through the swing that follows

events.summary: Zareth has caravanners shove an ox carcass over the edge as a distraction, then dives off the switchback as Verazol strikes.
events.quote: With great effort, they shove the ox's corpse over the edge of the switchback.

events.summary: Akiri catches the falling Zareth with her line, saving them both as Verazol devours the caravan above.
events.quote: She falls, catching Zareth's outstretched hand

events.summary: Zareth says he had no choice and Akiri comforts him; the two survivors reach the base and avoid Coralhelm on the road to Sea Gate.
events.quote: They waited a day, but no one else followed.

relations.note: Close friends who support each other through the Battle and the attack.
relations.quote: Akiri remained silent and held her friend as he sobbed
snapping up an ox. It pulls back, dragging a tangle of merfolk with it.

relations.note: It lurks in the waterfall as the demon of the Magosi.
relations.quote: flowing up and down the Magosi without effort
